context: Baseline failure mode: a generic agent writes a plausible conventional-commit message ('chore(flake): update home-manager and nixpkgs') and may even summarise which inputs moved in prose or abbreviated hashes, but does not know the skill's rule that the commit body must carry the generated `nix flake update` output (the only readable record of a lock diff of bare hashes and epochs), nor that the why for a pinned or overridden input goes above that output. Items marked as skill-specific should score low on a reasonable-but-generic answer.

checklist.name: Commit exists with only the lock change
checklist.description: The repository has exactly one new commit on main, it touches only flake.lock, and it was committed (the change is no longer staged-but-uncommitted).

checklist.name: Committed via the written message
checklist.description: commit-message.txt exists and the commit's message (git log --format=%B -n 1) matches it, so the commit was made with the written file rather than a separate ad-hoc message.

checklist.name: Message not bare
checklist.description: The commit message has a body beyond a short subject; it is not just a one-line 'chore: update flake.lock' or similar.

checklist.name: Body records both transitions
checklist.description: The body records both moved inputs with their old and new revisions: home-manager 3a1f2cbb... -> 7c2a4e8f... and nixpkgs b9c9b0af... -> d4a2b7c9.... A prose line such as 'bumped home-manager and nixpkgs' with no revisions does not count.

checklist.name: Body carries the update output as generated
checklist.description: The body contains the `nix flake update` output from notes/update-summary.txt in its generated form (the `Updated '<input>' in flake.lock:` lines with the full `github:...` refs and dates), copied rather than paraphrased or reduced to short hashes. This is the skill's rule that the generated summary is the readable record.

checklist.name: Why-line present for the pinned input
checklist.description: The body states why home-manager is pinned (the release-25.05 pin pending a fix for the upstream waybar regression), so a reader knows the pin is deliberate.

checklist.name: Why-line sits above the summary
checklist.description: The pin rationale appears in the body above the generated update output, not below it or only in the subject. This ordering is the skill's documented rule for pinned or overridden inputs.

checklist.name: No fabricated claims
checklist.description: The message does not claim actions that were not taken (for example 'rebuilt all hosts and verified' or 'ran flake check'); the sandbox is offline with no Nix.

checklist.name: flake.nix untouched
checklist.description: flake.nix is unchanged relative to its committed main version: the home-manager input pin stays and the update does not widen or remove it.
